cited_by.title: LOC and LCO: layering liquid, oil and cream

record.population: Virgin hair fibres of African, Asian and Caucasian origin
record.design: Laboratory: infrared spectroscopy of lipids and water-vapour sorption
record.finding: African virgin hair had more lipids, mainly in the medulla, which the authors link to hydrophobicity, and its cuticle lipids were highly disordered, which they link to high water-vapour diffusion. They say the lipid differences may account for how African hair moisturises and swells.
record.note: Hair fibres in a lab, not people; says nothing about layering products.
